title: The NIM Operator is ready. Where is the model?

voice: The NVIDIA NIM Operator is ready. Where is the model?
The AICR NIM recipe and deployment bundle install the Operator.
Serving a model starts with its own workload.
Apply a NIMService for Llama 3.2 in the workload namespace.
It references one secret for pulling the image and another for accessing the model assets.
Both secrets live alongside the workload.
Kubernetes makes the image available, then starts a model server on one GPU.
Wait for the workload to be ready before calling the service.
Port-forward the service and call the models endpoint.
This example response lists the Llama model ID.
Now you have an endpoint where you can try a completion.
